rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: High melanin saturation (approximately 85-90%) with localized pink/pale depigmentation visible along the lower margins of the nostrils and the philtrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor depigmented indentation on the upper right margin of the rhinarium; visible wear on the lower canines.
other_distinctive_markers: Open-mouth posture exposing the lower mandibular dentition (canines and incisors) and dark pigmented spots on the oral mucosa.
